newsitem.title: HONG KONG: GZI Transport IPO seen about 300 times subscribed.
newsitem.headline: GZI Transport IPO seen about 300 times subscribed.

text.p: The flotation of GZI Transport Ltd, the infrastructural spinoff of Guangzhou Investment Co Ltd, is seen about 300 times subscribed, market sources said at the close of public subscription on Friday.
An official statement on the subscription results is expected to be made on January 28. Dealing in the shares is expected to begin on January 30.
GZI Transport issued 250 million shares at HK$3.23 per share, with warrants on the basis of one warrant for every five shares.
Of the issue, 187.5 million shares were placed internationally and 62.5 million shares were offered to the public in Hong Kong.

In the public offer, 31.25 million shares were available for public subscription, 25 million shares were offered preferentially to existing shareholders of Guangzhou Investment and 6.25 million shares were for employee subscription.
